request: Analyze GSE178367 for the paper (Transcriptomic and Metabolic Network Analysis of Metabolic Reprogramming and IGF-1 Modulation in SCA3 Transgenic Mice): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (paired-end 150 bp, HISAT2 mm10, featureCounts) of total cerebellar RNA from 18-month-old YAC ATXN3 transgenic mice (S4.2.p1, S4.4.p1, S4.5.p2)
final.sample_inclusion: 9 cerebellar samples, 3 per group (GEO); no exclusions described
final.exercise_arm: none: no exercise, training, or physical-activity intervention anywhere in the paper; 'exercise behavior' (ABS.p1) and rotarod/locomotor tests (S1.p3) are outcome measures from a prior GH study, not an intervention
final.primary_estimand: Transcriptomic effect of SCA3 84Q genotype vs 15Q control in cerebellum, and of IGF-1 injection in 84Q mice (S1.p4, S2.2.p1); no exercise estimand
final.normalization: DESeq2 size factors; TPM for EDA and IPA (S4.5.p2, S4.6.p2)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 v1.12.3 Wald test, BH adjustment (S4.6.p2, S4.7.p1)
final.paper_results: S2.2.p1 reports counts 'with an adjusted p-value < 0.05' (521 / 588 / 6), which conflicts with the methods rule padj < 0.1 and |log2FC| >= log2(1.5) (S4.7.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Paper compares SCA3 84Q transgenic vs 15Q control mice and 84Q mice injected with IGF-1 (S4.1.p1, S1.p4). DE by DESeq2 Wald, BH, |log2FC| >= log2(1.5) and padj < 0.1 (S4.7.p1). No exercise arm exists; the request's exercise estimand is not part of this study.

checks: GEO treatment_protocol matches S4.1.p1 (PBS or IGF1 50 mg/kg weekly from 9 to 18 months)
3 groups x 3 cerebellar samples (15Q, 84Q, 84Q+IGF1) match the paper's groups
data_processing: Trimmomatic v0.36, hisat2, mm10, featureCounts, matching S4.5.p2

ownership.reasoning: Data availability statement and GEO protocols match the paper.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns are 'counts.<lab id>'; the lab id sits in brackets at the end of the GEO title (e.g. 'Cerebellar tissue - 84Q_rep1 [18_1_4]'). Exact match after stripping the 'counts.' prefix. Group from source_name_ch1, recoded to formula-safe names.

final.paper_input: featureCounts raw counts into DESeq2 (S4.5.p2, S4.7.p1)

matrix.reasoning: All values integer (integer_fraction 1.0, max 360695, median 10); GEO data_processing says raw counts from featureCounts; matches paper input.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the study's only factors are ATXN3 genotype (15Q vs 84Q) and IGF-1 injection (PBS vs IGF-1 in 84Q). No sample received an exercise or training intervention and no sedentary-vs-exercise grouping exists in the paper (S4.1.p1) or GEO metadata (source_name_ch1, genotype, treatment), so the requested exercise estimand cannot be identified. Manufacturing a genotype or IGF-1 contrast as 'exercise' would change the estimand.
design.reasoning: The request asks how exercise affects gene expression. The paper's estimands are SCA3 genotype and IGF-1 treatment effects; the word 'exercise' appears only as a behavioral outcome of prior GH treatment (ABS.p1). Refused at design.

discrepancies.data: Results S2.2.p1 reports DEG counts with 'adjusted p-value < 0.05'

discrepancies.paper: No exercise intervention; genotype and IGF-1 injection only (S4.1.p1)
